# Panel

Panel is a Python library for building powerful interactive dashboards, apps, and data tools entirely in Python.
This file lists the most important documentation pages for LLM-assisted development; not all generated doc links are shown.

All documentation is available as markdown files under /markdown/.

## Documentation

### getting started
> Install Panel and learn the core concepts.

- [build app](/markdown/getting_started/build_app.md)
- [core concepts](/markdown/getting_started/core_concepts.md)
- [installation](/markdown/getting_started/installation.md)
